dated_definition: Frozen strict in_analysis records with a nonempty integer year, including one 1895 dissertation. None of the 13 screened author keys is cited by that 1895 dissertation.

count_definitions.all_authorship: Deduplicated strict in_analysis dissertation IDs joined from citations.csv.gz to authorship.csv.gz for exactly one person_key, every authorship position; validates people.csv.gz. A name key is not necessarily an authority-controlled identity.
count_definitions.first_author: Deduplicated strict in_analysis dissertation IDs for work rows with exactly the person_key in first_author_key; this is the scope used by public P: source records. It can differ from all_authorship.
count_definitions.work: Deduplicated strict in_analysis dissertation IDs for exactly one work_id; validates cited_by_strict_phds. No sums across title variants/translations/editions.
